one_liner_zh: 迪爾EPS大幅超預期17.45%，淡季獲利展現成本控管成效。
one_liner_en: Deere beat EPS by a strong 17.45%, with off-season earnings showing cost-control effectiveness.
ai_view_zh: 訊號正向：17.45%的EPS大幅超標，顯示即便在農機需求疲弱與季節淡季，迪爾仍透過成本與產量紀律維持優異獲利能力。短期超標支撐情緒，但缺乏營收年增資料使成長趨勢判讀保守，市場關注通路去庫存進度。中期關鍵在農民收入回升與換購週期。追蹤指標：各部門營業利潤率、通路庫存、精準農業訂閱收入、全年淨利指引，以及農產品價格與農場現金收入趨勢。
ai_view_en: Signal is positive: a strong 17.45% EPS beat shows that even amid weak equipment demand and a seasonally soft quarter, Deere sustains excellent profitability through cost and production discipline. Near-term the beat supports sentiment, but the missing revenue YoY keeps the growth read conservative as the market watches channel destocking. Mid-term, recovering farm income and the replacement cycle are key. Track: segment operating margins, channel inventory, precision-ag subscription revenue, full-year net income guidance, and crop-price and farm cash-income trends.
highlights_zh: EPS 2.42美元，大幅超越預期2.06美元，正向驚喜17.45%
營收93.4億美元，反映農機季節性淡季規模
精準農業與自動化技術維持競爭優勢
嚴格成本與產量管理支撐淡季獲利
highlights_en: EPS of $2.42 strongly beat the $2.06 estimate, a 17.45% positive surprise
Revenue of $9.34B reflects a seasonally softer ag quarter
Precision agriculture and automation sustain competitive advantage
Disciplined cost and production management support off-season earnings
risks_zh: 營收年增資料缺失，成長趨勢判讀受限
農產品價格疲弱抑制設備需求
本益比33.07在週期股相對偏高
risks_en: Missing revenue YoY limits the read on growth trends
Weak crop prices suppress equipment demand
A 33.07x P/E is relatively high for a cyclical
